author: felicepantaleo
body:
The alpaka 2.2.0 `Philox4x32x10` does not compute the Random123 Philox4x32-10 function: it fails all three Random123 known-answer vectors. This PR applies to alpaka 2.2.0 the fixes of alpaka-group/alpaka#2737: the multiplier order, the round count, the offset and the skip carry of the Philox engines, the start block and the offset of `Philox4x32x10Vector`, 64-bit seeds in `createDefault` and `Philox4x32x10Vector`, `UniformUint` for narrow types and `bool`, and `UniformReal` in [min, max) for any engine. alpaka-group/alpaka#2737 is merged into `develop` (e705ec991). The patch is `git diff 61c5a7113 e705ec991 -- include/alpaka/rand`, the change of that PR to `include/alpaka/rand`. It changes only files under `include/alpaka/rand` and applies to the 2.2.0 tag with no offset or fuzz.

The numbers of every Philox engine change. In CMSSW the only user of `alpaka::rand` is `PhysicsTools/PyTorchAlpakaTest`, which uses it to fill test inputs.

Tests in a CMSSW_20_1_0_pre5 area with the patched headers (2x Tesla T4):

- `alpaka::rand::PhiloxStateless4x32x10Vector` returns the Random123 values, on the serial and the CUDA backends.
- The tests `testPyTorchAlpakaTestSerialSync` and `testPyTorchAlpakaTestCudaAsync` pass.

Remove the patch when CMSSW moves to an alpaka release that contains the fixes.
title: alpaka: apply the Philox and seeding fixes to 2.2.0
